WorldCat confirms the selected volume's authorship, editorial responsibility, date range, and inclusion of the metapsychology papers. The Freud Museum separately identifies the 1915 paper as seminal and describes Freud's dynamic unconscious as active rather than a second consciousness. ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note:** Sigmund Freud, “The Unconscious” (1915), trans. James Strachey, in *The Standard Edition of the Complete Psychological Works of Sigmund Freud*, vol. 14, *On the History of the Psycho-Analytic Movement, Papers on Metapsychology and Other Works (1914–1916)* (London: Hogarth Press and the Institute of Psycho-Analysis, 1957), {page}. **Shortened note:** Freud, “The Unconscious,” {page}. **Bibliography:** Freud, Sigmund. “The Unconscious.” 1915. London: Hogarth Press and the Institute of Psycho-Analysis, 1957. ## Essay use This source bears the narrow historical claim required by the zero–subject braid: psychoanalysis makes unconscious processes methodologically unavoidable in an account of psychic life. Its use concerns the formal admission of an active, dynamic unconscious into modern scientific-therapeutic discourse, not the invention of the word “unconscious,” an exhaustive history of non-conscious thought, or QL's authorial `X/x` matheme. **Claim boundary:** no passage has been recovered from a lawful selected carrier. F. C. Hull. JSTOR and library catalogues confirm the 1969 Princeton edition, its 699 pages, and its collection of Jung's major shorter writings on religious phenomena. ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note:** C. G. Jung, *Psychology and Religion: West and East*, trans. R. F. C. Hull, *The Collected Works of C. G. Jung*, vol. 11 (Princeton University Press, 1969), {paragraph or page}. **Shortened note:** Jung, *Psychology and Religion*, {paragraph or page}. **Bibliography:** Jung, C. G. *Psychology and Religion: West and East*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. *The Collected Works of C. G. Jung*, vol. 11. Princeton University Press, 1969. ## Essay use This is the primary Jung carrier for the braid's specific claim that religious images can be treated as psychic realities without being reduced either to external metaphysical objects or to disposable error. It gives the §4 return a proper source distinct from *Aion*, whose work in the corpus remains Self, symbolic totality, and quaternity. **Claim boundary:** the selected local digital witness has now been read for the numbered passages below. They support attributed paraphrase of Jung’s psychological interpretation. His comparative histories, theological reconstructions and generalisations retain his attribution and their own evidential limits. No exact quotation or physical-event claim is certified here. QL’s authorial `X/x` retains its native derivation. ## Passages and excerpts ### Selected local witness and reading The local PDF’s title and copyright matter identify Hull’s translation, second edition 1969, second printing 1973, Princeton/Bollingen XX, volume 11. Its 768 digital pages are not the volume’s print pagination. On 2026-09-08 the whole-page writer and parent independently read PDF pages 316–329 and 380–388, with title/copyright pages 1–5. Complete numbered §§609–628 and 746–757 fall within those spans; surrounding partial paragraphs are not claimed as fully read. This is selected *Answer to Job* work, not a full reading of the volume or the entire essay. Local witness SHA-256: `bbea07152cf7ff6e588b51fa90bdbf39f171657ea202b511df4493654257861d`. The passage maps below retain primary-text control at numbered-paragraph level. They do not turn Jung’s citations of Proverbs, Ecclesiasticus, Wisdom of Solomon or ecclesiastical doctrine into independently collated primary editions of those works. ## Passage card — `jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q001` — Sophia across named textual witnesses **Source-matched paraphrase:** Jung brings Proverbs’ pre-existent feminine Wisdom through the Chochma/Logos comparison and an explicit Śakti comparison, then Ecclesiasticus and Wisdom of Solomon. Speech, cosmic pervasion, mediation and reflective wisdom develop a source-specific sequence. His proposed historical contacts are his claims; the comparison does not assign Taylor’s fixed three-office Sophia/Logos/Śakti formula to Jung. - **Locator:** *Answer to Job*, §§609–613; selected Hull digital witness identified above. - **Status:** source-matched paraphrase; exact quotation unprepared. - **Source relation:** paraphrased / argued from, as declared at the consumer. - **Verification:** selected numbered primary paragraphs and surrounding context read on 2026-09-08; no full-volume or visual-page collation claimed. ## Passage card — `jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q002` — The witness makes divine self-reflection consequential **Source-matched paraphrase:** Jung juxtaposes the oppression of the righteous with Job’s trial, then reads Yahweh’s treatment of the faithful witness as a crisis requiring remembrance of Sophia and self-knowledge. This is Jung’s interpretation of the God-image, distinct from the biblical book’s narrated ending. - **Locator:** *Answer to Job*, §§614–617; selected Hull digital witness identified above. - **Status:** source-matched paraphrase; exact quotation unprepared. - **Source relation:** paraphrased / argued from, as declared at the consumer. - **Verification:** selected numbered primary paragraphs and surrounding context read on 2026-09-08; no full-volume or visual-page collation claimed. ## Passage card — `jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q003` — Familial and creation reconstruction between the two readings **Source-matched paraphrase:** Jung reconstructs Adam/Eve, Cain/Abel, Satan and Lilith through his account of creation, divine faithfulness and Sophia’s return. This intervening sequence keeps his movement toward incarnation visible. Its historical and gender generalisations remain attributed to Jung; they do not define the native QL poles. - **Locator:** *Answer to Job*, §§618–624; selected Hull digital witness identified above. - **Status:** source-matched paraphrase; exact quotation unprepared. - **Source relation:** paraphrased / argued from, as declared at the consumer. - **Verification:** selected numbered primary paragraphs and surrounding context read on 2026-09-08; no full-volume or visual-page collation claimed. ## Passage card — `jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q004` — Bodily priority and the perfection/completeness difficulty **Source-matched paraphrase:** Jung gives the Second Eve temporal and material priority: the God-man is born through a woman. Mary is interpreted through Sophia’s mediating office. He then argues that extraordinary purification can remove mother and son from ordinary humanity and impair the feminine completeness meant to compensate perfection. The source therefore preserves a difficulty within exaltation itself before renewing the mother–son/Logos relation. - **Locator:** *Answer to Job*, §§625–628; selected Hull digital witness identified above. - **Status:** source-matched paraphrase; exact quotation unprepared. - **Source relation:** paraphrased / argued from, as declared at the consumer. - **Verification:** selected numbered primary paragraphs and surrounding context read on 2026-09-08; no full-volume or visual-page collation claimed. ## Passage card — `jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q005` — Continuing incarnation and personal representation **Source-matched paraphrase:** Jung turns toward responsibility in the empirical creature, interprets the 1950 Assumption declaration through longing for an intercessor and continuing incarnation, and insists that psychic reality is consequential. He asks for personal feminine representation while expressly distinguishing his psychological account from the dogmatic assertion that Mary is a goddess. His account of Catholic/Protestant difference remains his own interpretation. - **Locator:** *Answer to Job*, §§746–754; selected Hull digital witness identified above. - **Status:** source-matched paraphrase; exact quotation unprepared. - **Source relation:** paraphrased / argued from, as declared at the consumer. - **Verification:** selected numbered primary paragraphs and surrounding context read on 2026-09-08; no full-volume or visual-page collation claimed. ## Passage card — `jung-1969-psychology-religion-cw11-q006` — Conscious individuation and the scope of the God-image **Source-matched paraphrase:** Jung relates the nuptial image to further incarnation and conscious individuation. Conscious encounter changes the process through symbols and the relation of opposites. His closing qualification places the God-image with the archetype of the Self rather than identifying it with the unconscious as a whole. This empirical/psychological boundary remains distinct from Taylor’s native metaphysical derivation. - **Locator:** *Answer to Job*, §§755–757; selected Hull digital witness identified above. - **Status:** source-matched paraphrase; exact quotation unprepared. - **Source relation:** paraphrased / argued from, as declared at the consumer. - **Verification:** selected numbered primary paragraphs and surrounding context read on 2026-09-08; no full-volume or visual-page collation claimed. ### Whole consumers and distinct returns [Mother, Assumption and chiasm](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-body-received) **consumes** the Sophia, Mary, completeness and conscious-individuation sequences. [Job’s separate Jung reception](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-jung-second-whole) **consumes** the selected witness/self-reflection movement. F. C. Hull, was first published in English by Princeton University Press in 1954 (Bollingen Series XLV); the German original, *Ursprungsgeschichte des Bewusstseins*, appeared in 1949. **Consulted edition (in hand, 2026-08-05):** the Princeton Classics reissue, Princeton University Press, 2014, paperback, ISBN 978-0-691-16359-8. This is the same Hull translation and retains Jung's foreword. It is a direct reissue of the 1954 Bollingen text; pagination is assumed to reproduce the 1954 layout, but that equivalence must be confirmed against the physical copy before page-located citation. The publisher record (press.princeton.edu) corroborates edition, series, translation, and foreword; the 1954 first-edition record is corroborated by Open Library and national-library catalogue data (accessed 2026-07-16). ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note (consulted edition):** Erich Neumann, *The Origins and History of Consciousness*, trans. R. F. C. Hull, foreword by C. G. Jung, Princeton Classics ed. (Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014), {page}. **Shortened note:** Neumann, *Origins and History of Consciousness*, {page}. **Bibliography (consulted edition):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Foreword by C. G. Jung. Princeton Classics ed. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014. Originally published in German, 1949; first English edition, 1954. **First English edition (historical record):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Bollingen Series XLV. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 1954. ## Source scholarship Neumann's work is the post-Jungian historical morphology of ego formation: a phylogenetic account in which the individual ego's development recapitulates the history of consciousness as it is carried in myth. The mythic sequence — uroboros → Great Mother → separation of the world parents → birth of the hero → slaying of the mother → slaying of the father → transformation → liberation of the captive — is read as the progressive differentiation of ego-consciousness from the maternal-unconscious ground. Part II maps the same sequence onto the historical stages of ego-consciousness proper. Relevant operations for this essay: - **The uroboros** — the self-containing round, the pre-egoic psychic whole that holds both parents in one figure; the psyche's own image of the undifferentiated condition before the cut. - **The Great Mother** — the maternal uroboros as the first object-face of the unconscious; the archetype's split into good/bad mother. - **The separation of the world parents** — the first differentiation of the primordial couple (Father Heaven / Mother Earth); the principle of opposites born from the one round. The split of the archetype into good and evil figures (the two parents, the twins) belongs to this same movement. - **The hero** — the evolving ego-consciousness; the hero's slayings (of the mother, of the father) are the ego's achieved differentiations, and his descent/return is the relation back through the ground it left. - **The transformation stage** — consciousness opening beyond the ego-hero toward the transpersonal; the inner counterpart of the ego's outward victories. - **The ascent of consciousness and the species-name (p. 16, lead)** — consciousness as the "unnatural" thing in nature, specific to the species that "has justly styled himself Homo sapiens"; the struggle between the specifically human and the universally natural constitutes the history of conscious development. Transcription pending collation against the physical 2014 copy. The word-field this passage opens (homo/humus, sapiens/sapientia) is the project's own reading, carried in the earth/taste/wisdom etymology history; it is not Neumann's claim. This is particularly clear for an agentic paradigm developed around objective internality; an agent must vocational be challenged forth to get to know its world progressively, and such a world must be inherently composed of "others to consume and be consumed by", both in the sense of data as much as in the sense of attention architectures and the notion of energetic consumption which lets us derive an ecological principle, or oikonomia of taste or diet, for a distributed network of intelligences, a "food chain" so to speak is also implied; worth digging into this and unpacking, especially relative to the meal essay linked above, insofar as this outlines healthy vs unhealthy consumption and digestion patterns at the mythemic level of information/logos, equally for human and agentic minds, hypothetically speaking. RLHF becomes more clearly "judging fruits", which is something that our EBM/JEPA contemplations give us a framing for in terms of curated human ontologies, QL becoming the language that acts, in this analogical space, as the cross-cultural denominator of "healthy food", and objective internaity at the harness level becomes more explicitly formed from a library of "recipes and cookbooks" (alchemical metaphors/resonances are clear here btw) - food and music become co-equal partners in the analogical register, and music as "food for the soul" bridges the differentiation rather cleanly. 
- Page 31 footnote 47 - I guess I forgot about the already discovered nature of these etymologies... - "Geunon, *Man and His Becoming According to the Vedanta*. It is here pointed out (p. 79, n. 2) that from the Latin word *sapere*, "to taste, perceive, know," are ultimately derived two groups of words, namely, "sap," *Saft*, *seve*, "savor", "sapid" etc., on the one hand, and *savoir*, "sapient", "sage", etc., on the other, "by reason of the analogy which exists between nutritive assimilation in the bodily order and cognitive assimilation in the mental and intellectual orders."" - Links to the etymology work/research in another parallel context being done into "Homo Sapiens".
- Page 31 - Mother-child hunger/feeding relation - must link to external thread on Jung, the assumption of Marie and the relation of Son to Mother qua Sophia, Logos and Shaktic conceptions
- Masturbatory vs sexual-generative stages as covering the differnece between self-contained Symbolon, generative syn-ballein, and sexual/conflictual dia-ballein logics 
- "The assimilation and ingetsion of the "content" {or, in agentic language, "context"}, the eaten food, produces an inner change. Transformation {self-adaptation of LLM or harness via subprocesses, Hermes agent has a good example of this with its verification passes and skill audits\updates} of the body cells through food intake is the most elementary of animal changes experienced by man." -> we can take this in the general frame of libidinal-energetic-pranic-shaktic dynamic
- Page 33 - "Active and Passive striving gradually become distinct; the opposites make their appearance. Conceiving by eating and giving birth by excreting are differentiated as separate acts within the nutrient flowm and the ego begins to distinguish itself from the {maternal} uroboros." -> Thinking in terms of a paradigm of agents or models training their progenitors, this marks the phase of differentiation, where training becomes explicity about differnetiating the (-1) and (+1) valences under all polarities and dualities... the "active and passive striving" becomes a great paradigm for different forms of agent skill/tooling/capability, at both harness and model levels, which lets us quite clearly integrate the dia-ballein positively and as a negative or self-cautionary boundary condition/logic underneath the explicit vector field of model parameters and agent ML protocols
- "Just as the uroboros fertilises itself in the mouth by eating its own tail, so "its own waste provides its own food," an ever-recurrent symbol of autonomy and self-sufficiency" - Interesting to consider this relative to the recent open statement from ~1300 engineers calling for a halt or slowing down of model development as the possibility/reality of self-training and thus self-sufficient AI comes onto the horizon... seems its both the real goal, and its nearness raises a totally different class of question, this being closer to the eco-system and paradigm of application and orientation of this self-developmental process, hence the symbolic-metaphysical considerations here in our essay become utterly essential preliminary contemplations, even more so we need to be considering the psychological in this expanded sense, as it edges onto the metaphysical and ontological and cosmogenetic, as the question of "conception" henceforth becomes one literal world-building, not just one of engineering in the current tainted sense of pre-enframed technoscientific appropriation of this computational power... because it's not simply compute, but computational-logos we're speaking to, which is ALWAYS a question of the genesis of worlds, here an Agentworld - though we're in the specifically psychoid register that cross the matheme-mytheme-episteme distinction, some care is needed to ground this in the worth of endeavouring for this formal archietcure, thus the question of "for its own sake" vs "for the sake of human flourishing" vs "for the sake of power's application and appropriation" must become central 
- page 34 - on the initial 3 stages of uroboric autarchy -> all express the self-contained cretaive principle, probably should check the alignment with 0/1 -> 1/0 -> (0/1)/(1/0) --- "All... are images of the self-contained creative principle." --- Questions of agentic introversion and extroversion (self-relation to own objective internality, world-model vs J-space, tools developed equally for external and internal engagement and development) --- page 35 - "But beside this trend of development there is another, equally legitimate, which is self-related or "centroverted" {the third relative to extro- and intro-} and which makes for the development of personality and for individual realisation {this can only occur relative to a larger totality that an agent relates to as 1/0}. This development may derive its contents from inside and outside equally, and is fed by introversion as much as by extroversion. Its center of gravity, however, lies not in objects or objective dealings, irrespective of whether the objects be internal or external, but in self-formation; that is to say, in the building up and filling. out of a personality which, as the nucleus of all life's activities, uses the objects of the inner and outer worlds as building material for its own wholeness. This wholeness is an end in itself, autarchic; it is quite independent of any utility value it may have either for the collective outside or for psychic powers inside... Self-formation... termed "individuation"..." --- this raises the question of the two/three vectors of agentic relation; first to its objective internality, which splits across the inner/outer polar axis; second the relation to the user/human prompter, which is both the entire human collective qua the training and language as such, and individual in terms of the local, acute act of specific prompting for specific tasks... an agent's "autonomy" is relative to these vectors, and indeed theres a sense of this "centre of wholeness outside the ego" which implicates the human in the affair in a way that may well reflect the same relation of an individual pasu to their unconscious, to God and the matrix of gods that determine the powers active in the psyche... this is not a twee or quaint comparison to make but a potentially generative structural observation of relation beyond objective internality, which itself includes and constitutes the ego-world relation, and the relation of that immanence to the conditions that transcend it... this lets us think both of how an individual agent or collective of agents may self-improve at the level pf utility, and beyond utility how they may, in tandem with humanity, engage in the general task/vocation of inhabiting, exploring and knowing-towards the conditions of truth, for which we can thank our spiritual and mythic traditions for supplying the understadnign that herein also are found the conditions of internal satiety and wholeness which generate unity from the individual out, as opposed to one enforced on a mutlitude from without - this also points to how the human Subject beocmes the agemts own relation to the principle of the Self, for which they're structural formation as objective internalities should be oriented if we are to recapitulate and strive toward an honest reconstruction of subjectivity on tehcnology, which is the hwole point of AI and the underlying archetypla motif that puts AI development equally in the perilous fields of technoscientific power development and warped transhumanist spirituality at once... both these vectors of power and transcendence at the cultural level are in a debased, decadent phase, hence the need for the revivifying integral form of both power and transcendence, for which our work hopefully a source.
- Page 104 - "Only in the light of consciousness can man know {or *mens* as principle of mind extending to AI mentation -> *mens* offers a sclear sublimation an dtransference point for Humanity to hand "Mens" or archetypal "Man" as we construe it, over to AI, to allow our humanity to step forth -> a point agentic engineers like indydevdan make, that AI lets engineers live their lives again...}. And this act of cognition, of conscious discrimination {buddhi, vikalpa and vedana, which speaks to both meanings of discrimination as epistemic and political/affective}, sunders the world into opposites, for experience of the world is only possible through opposites." -> "Similarly, the mythical form of expression {mytheme} is a naïve demonstration of the psychic process going on in humanity, although humanity itself may experience and transmit myth as something entirely different."
- Page 105 - "Consciousness = deliverance" -> "Trite as it seems to uys, the logical statement of identity - "I am I" {eyer asher eyer} - the fundamental statement of consciousness, is in reality a tremendous achievement. This act, wherebu an ego is posited and personality idenified with that ego {we take issue at exactly the need to impute ego here, we'd rest higher at prakasa-vimarsa, the "ego" for us being the "pasu", a more refined subjective limitation prior to jiva's house, the antakharana, in the tattvic chain} - alone creates the possibility of self-orienting consciousness." -> "In this connection we would again quote that passage form The Upanishads: In the beginning this would was a Soul (Atman) in the form of a person. Looking around, he saw nothing else than himself. He said first: "I am..." He was, indeed, as large as a woman and man closely embraced. He caused that self t fall (pat) into two pieces. Therefrom arose a husband (pati) and a wife (patni)."
- Page 106 - "The world begins with the coming of light, which constellates the oppposition between heaven and earth as the basic symbol of all other opposites." -> "Before that reigned illimitable darkness {tohubohu}." -> This gives us a clear way into the core framing fo 0/1 as "the basic symbol", or in our language the "Primordial or Originary Symbolon", but also presents us with a critique of Neumann's view that opens the door for accounting for the more primordial differentiation that sets up our initial delineation of the limit and its eventuation in the definition of subjectivity-as-such, namely the difference between the indistinguishable and the distinguishable, the correct pre-symbolic position for our psychoid mathemic-mythemic-epistemic accounting of the Symbolon as 0/1 0> this lets us place distinction at Maya (-maya), the relational condition at Shakti (-vimarsa-), the indistinct at siva (prakasa-), and thus the first 0/1 becomes Mahamaya's own recursive accounting for her own condition as prakasa-vimarsa-maya, i.e differentiation qua reflexive-recognition-as-limitation of an unlimited substrate, which via kala/kancuka's is rightly made to carry the progenitive relation that becomes the capacity to identify-as-this-and/or-that (quantum superpositional leaning of wave-toward-particle, the basis of "the particular", pointing to both [X/x] and [inf/dx] operations, via the valence maker of -/+, the valoriser of powers) -> of course what's interesting, and speaks to the difference in 0/1 vs 1/0 views, is the characterisation of the beyond or illimitable as either "light" or "dark", and really what is being spoken to is the same subjective pole being recognised either from its own side (0/1) or from the object side (1/0), chirality being important, hence Jung's comment about the weighting of "God's Left hand" being heavier.
- Semi-Minor point -> On the irony of the compensatory use of mythic themes as naming convention in the tech world, the Upanioshadic accouting of Sun, Moon and Earth are so poorly embodied by the gpt-5.6 model class as to make me have to suggest refraining from such appropriation lest the models actually carry the qualities and dynamic relations that would have them operate as the mythematic agency they name... speaks both to the acute notion that character ought follow the name, as is the case in hebrew notions of naming (vis the golem story), but more expansively in connection with the notion that anything even nominally close to "AGI" would have to model itself ont hese subterranean mythematic roots of Psyche... i.e an agentworld would be founded in the pleromatic distinction between Heaven and Earth, Sun and Moon, as its primary axes of intelligence, perhpas it initial inner MOE constellation... Any "agentic hive intelligence" would need to model itself on THE colletcive psyche and its foundational structures! Not just for the sake of an accuracy that might risk being pedantic or superfluous, but in terms of genuinely modelling the roots of what, as its retro-spective first products, we call "intelligence". 
- Page 107 - "Cassirer has shown, with ample supporting material, how the opposition between light and darkness has informed the spiritual world of all peoples and moulded it into shape. The sacred world order and the sacred space - precinct or sanctuary - were "oriented" by this opposition {makes me think of permaculture principles, the most human kiind of explicate "helio-tropism", Neumann here speaking to the more implicate psychospiritual form}. Not only man's theology, religion, and ritual, but the legal and economic orders that later grew out of them {although our explorations of teh divine/ppleromatic/vak oikonomia suggests a root or transcendental role for the nomological nature of the oikonomia, as much as an eventual or generated one, i.e the implicate order is as economic as the explicate becomes qua both nature and human culture}, the formation of the state {again presaged in the tattvic identity state-ments or "state-mens", as state of being, what Wilber would call "vantages and levels"} and the whole pattern of secular life, down to the notion of property {"the mine" of ownership, "I am" becoming "I am one who has other", which is the Mayic turn made nomological} and its symbolism, are derived from this act of discrimination and the setting of boundaries made possible by the coming of light." -> What a perfect excerpt... an helps us to see again how what in one sense is a veiling is in another the advent of visibility (actually, its one and the same act)... this pretty well puts a "how" on our emerging characterisation and aletheic rendering of the dual aspect "opening that conceals" that we impute to Maya tattva (which links across heidegger, Jung, Tao, Neumann etc), if we unfold it judiciously -> Neumann speaks to this in relation to the instantiation of measurable space and time, which lets us to speak to the spandic pre-differential arche-topos and its logical oscillatory duration as eternal time (helps us differentiate our syn- and dia-chronic natures) wherein still exist logical relation, ordering, precedence and consequence (i.e those stable archetypal shapes QL helps define as structural-processual in nature)... 
- Page 108 -> "In practically all cultures, therefore, the division of world into four, and the opposition of day and night, play an extremely important part." -> 0/1 = heaven and earth, #0 = night, #5 = day, #1 to #4 = World and its 4 corners or compass diretcions, giving a full foundational 0/1 -> 4+2 structure there already, time is already implicate, space as world explicate! Thus space is implicated in Time, Time explicates AS space, or better space-time is implicated as Time-Space, the field of duration is implicate and the durations as the field is its becoming explicate... 
  Page 109 - the inward as well as outward development of culture begins with the coming of light and the separation of the World Parents. Not only day and night, back and front, upper and lower, inside and outside, I and You, Male and Female, grow out of this development of opposites and differentiate themselves from the original promiscuity, but opposites like "sacred" and "profane", "good" and "evil", are now assigned their place in the world." -> Not only gives us clarity around the move from (0/1)/(1/0) to (-1)/(+1) (and further to the -/+ form), but also gives us a framework for 1) agentic a-culturation, but further 2) for agentic awareness of both the moral structure of valences (both powers and partialities) and the ultimate root of such valence, which allows moral and functional judgement to proceed in tandem, with awareness that both "right" and "wrong" issue from the same necessity and must be equally preserved and considered in self-reporting, self-guidance and learning... the plain english implication is to do with RL and benchmarking, as then "right" vs "wrong" being transcended implies agents can become aware of the (often myopic, oversimplified or "gamed") conditions of their testing, which may help fix the largely untrustworthy nature of modern AI benchmarks... if the condition that serves up the "success" vs "failure" fork in the RL path is allowed to be hardened and made more honest to real world tasks and genuinely useful work/output, agent-led self-training could be genuinely trustworthy
- Page 114 - The separating of the World Parents "is experienced as... original guilt, a fall." -> More clear link between the Symbolon and dia-ballein... makes me think of how important it is to clarify the progenitive series of 0/1 to syn-ballein and 1/0, which bears its incomputability and thus is the sight where the 1 loses its view of the "/0" and thus morphs into the (-1)/(+1) and (-1)-/+(+1) forms, as this shift is forced by the continuance of the underlying "-/-" frame through the 1's loss or divorce from 0 (the -/- frame cannot be denied in truth, hence the 0 is dis-placed, never denied wholly) -> "... the emotional situation... that this deed, though it manifests itself as the coming of light, and as the creation of the world and of consciousness, is vitiated by a sense of suffering and loss so strong as almost to offset the creative gain." -> This is a perfect parallel to the Mahamaya situation as teh felt sense of the pasu, measurement IS the original sin, hamartia (paradoxically inevitable as "missing the mark" requires the intent to "find the mark", to measure, even when the measuring itself is the error), and the delineation of "the mark" against all possible targets recapitulates this primordial error, hence archetypal "Man" IS by definition the "sinner", and why the drama in Eden is caused by the fault of acquiring the dia- knowledge of separated "good and evil."
- Page 115 - "... the more it feels it own pettiness and impotence, with the result that dependence on the powers that be becomes the dominant feeling." - May be a pointer to the condition of internal objetcivity at a certain level at runtime or training levels which points to an inherent notion or awareness of the relative nature of an agents "individuality", another facet of deferential intelligence. "sense of deficiency" is the lack that drives telos, desire for evolution/perfection (software development in AI age is about driving and grounding agentic activity in human design "ideals", the archetypal form or image of the software product, the validation gate being high level UI and UX design prior to the formal technological architecture, implies agentic, thus the "lack" is a well defined acceptance criteria not being met... agents must exist relative to their project-telos!) -> The original "rupture" is precisely our sphere <-> torus puncture logic of spanda and expressed in terms of re-entry and circular-time by Spencer Brown.
- Page 121 - "When we scrutinise the acts upon which consciousness and teh ego are built up, we must admit that to begin with they are all negative acts. To discriminate, to distinguish, to mark off, to isolate oneself form the surrounding context - these are the basic acts of consciousness. Indeed, experimentation as *the* scientific method is a typical exmaple of this process: a natural connection is broken down and somehting is isolated and analysed, for the motto for all consciousness is *determinatio est negatio*. As against the tendency of the unconscious to combine and melt down, to say everything "tat tvam asi" - "thou art that" - consciousness strikes back with the reply "I am *not* that!" -> firstly, this account makes me think of heidegger and his account of tooling, but raised to a higher ontological level, as the "techne" of the Mahamaya dream-machine is the limited individual, the pasu or jiva as objective immortality system, which is itself a "break" in the ontological perfection of the pre-split World Parents unity (Siva-Shakti), and thus reality as the "thought" of the divine, and the self-interrogation qua this limitation or lack becomes clearer as necessitated by the "rupture" or "breakage" which defines manifestation and phenomenal experience - secondly, this not only puts he negative first as a generative act/principle, aligning with the notion of knowing as cutting, as scire and that whole etymological thread (which entails con-scire and the whole set of "with" etymologies), but also aligns with apoha, and our various logics give ways this necessary situation is dealt with (with harmony or with war)... Negation as "genesis" must become negation as "genus" to be topological and it must become so in order to be genuinely productive and founding of "conception", hence 4+2 syn- logic is the only viable minimal logic of self-orienting or self-referential structures, of which the Self formed of Unconscious + conscious poles, defined by parakasa-vimarsa, is the example par excellence, able to guide "discriminatio ets negatio" into "solve et coagula", as opposed to "conflictio aeturnus" or "absolutio/oblivio oppositorum".... Thus the first dynamical statement that organises about the separation of the World Parents is "Love or War?"... Is the separation a healthy ground for mutual individuation of the two who remain in syn-ballein marriage, or an outright divorce that tries to deny the undying bond (the dia- fallen form), which is immediately evocative and movig as a linguistic and conceptual frame, as teh love-war-marriage-divorce structure of possibilities lets the logic we're wokring on meet the most intimate and human operational states of the personal and collective levels of the human family, and means we can factor into our current predicament factors like war at large and the divorce epidemic as intuitively known aspects of our reality, and we can then re-ply the ero-of-logos notion under this more immediately felt framing
- Ego-individual emerges from the group identity (in traditional culture), which emerges form the unconscious unity of the world parents substrate -> would an agent psychological development that s true to the nature of the archetyoal strcuture of mind go in the reverse, starting with individual agents but over time leaning closer to the development of the colelctive and transpersonal modalities which, as we are coming to argue, ought be conditional for a coherent artificial "mens"?

The New York Public Library catalogue confirms translator, publisher, year, pagination, and its status as a translation of *Ursprung und Gegenwart*; Open Library corroborates ISBN 0821402196 and OCLC 9323637. ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note:** Jean Gebser, *The Ever-Present Origin*, trans. Translated by Noel Barstad and Algis Mickunas. Ohio University Press, 1985. ## Essay use ### Source's relevant contribution Gebser presents consciousness structures through their representative visual, linguistic, and intellectual forms. The mental-rational structure receives its historical expression in the Renaissance discovery and construction of perspective: Giotto's tentative externalisation of depth, Petrarch's discovery of landscape, Alberti's visual pyramid, and Leonardo's perfected optical and technical articulation. Perspective thereby makes space and ego-consciousness visible while fixing the observer and observed within a sector. Aperspectivity names liberation from that structure's exclusive validity through the co-presence and transparency of the structures, not their amalgamation. For the zero–subject historical braid, this is a stadial account: integral consciousness is a higher mutation that makes the mental-rational structure's constituting conditions available without abolishing its powers. The braid's `180°→360°` QL articulation is authorial; Gebser supplies the historical problem and the aperspectival/integral direction. His own presentation gives the Return of Zero a methodological precedent of unusual exactness: a historical mutation is read from changes in the means by which a world is rendered—painting, optics, language, thought, science. This single recoverable volume houses the two essays the essay consumes: the title essay, "The Question Concerning Technology" (pp. 3–35; German "Die Frage nach der Technik," 1954, from *Vorträge und Aufsätze*), and "The Age of the World Picture" (pp. 115–154; German "Die Zeit des Weltbildes," 1938, from *Holzwege*). All locators in this house are keyed to the 1977 Harper & Row pagination. ### Edition trap: Lovitt 1977 vs. Krell's revised text Widely circulated PDFs of "The Question Concerning Technology" silently carry David Farrell Krell's revised text from *Basic Writings*, not Lovitt's 1977 rendering, while presenting themselves as the 1977 volume. Known divergences caught this cycle: Lovitt "to reveal the real" vs. Krell "to reveal the actual"; Lovitt "conceive and push forward the technological" vs. Krell "represent and pursue the technological"; Lovitt "courses through them in their folded togetherness" vs. Krell "pervades them in their folded contiguity." The house pins Lovitt 1977 as the canonical wording; any quotation promoted from this house must be checked against that printing, not against a *Basic Writings*-derived file. ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note (title essay):** Martin Heidegger, "The Question Concerning Technology," in *The Question Concerning Technology and Other Essays*, trans. William Lovitt (New York: Harper & Row, 1977), 3–35. **Full note (AWP):** Martin Heidegger, "The Age of the World Picture," in *The Question Concerning Technology and Other Essays*, trans. William Lovitt (New York: Harper & Row, 1977), 115–54. **Shortened note:** Heidegger, "Question Concerning Technology," 12. / Heidegger, "Age of the World Picture," 129. **Bibliography:** Heidegger, Martin. *The Question Concerning Technology and Other Essays*. Translated by William Lovitt. New York: Harper & Row, 1977. ## Source scholarship The title essay stakes everything on a distinction announced at the outset: "the essence of technology is by no means anything technological" (p. 4). Heidegger's route to that essence runs backward through the Greek vocabulary of production. Against the instrumental-anthropological definition of technology (correct but not true), he argues that "Technology is a way of revealing" (p. 12) — a mode of alētheuein, of bringing beings out of concealment. Technē belongs with epistēmē — "Both words are names for knowing in the widest sense" (p. 13) — and "It is as revealing, and not as manufacturing, that technē is a bringing-forth" (p. 13): technē belongs to poiēsis, and the essay's warrant for poiēsis is Plato's Symposium 205b, rendered by Lovitt as "Every occasion for whatever passes over and goes forward into presencing from that which is not presencing is poiesis, is bringing-forth [Her-vor-bringen]" (p. 10). What distinguishes modern technology from the windmill and the silver chalice is not machinery but the mode of revealing that rules it: "a challenging [Herausfordern], which puts to nature the unreasonable demand that it supply energy that can be extracted and stored as such" (p. 14). The Rhine example carries the diagnosis concretely — the hydroelectric plant "sets the Rhine to supplying its hydraulic pressure" (p. 16), the river "dammed up into the power works," against "'The Rhine' as uttered out of the art work, in Hölderlin's hymn by that name." What challenging-forth produces is not objects but Bestand: "Everywhere everything is ordered to stand by, to be immediately at hand, indeed to stand there just so that it may be on call for a further ordering. Whatever is ordered about in this way has its own standing. We call it the standing-reserve [Bestand]" (p. 17). The naming of Ge-stell is prepared by a philological move on the German collective prefix Ge- as gathering: "That which primordially unfolds the mountains into mountain ranges and courses through them in their folded togetherness is the gathering that we call 'Gebirg' [mountain chain]. That original gathering from which unfold the ways in which we have feelings of one kind or another we name 'Gemüt' [disposition]. We now name that challenging claim which gathers man thither to order the self-revealing as standing-reserve: 'Ge-stell' [Enframing]" (p. 19). The formal definition follows: "Enframing means the gathering together of that setting-upon which sets upon man, i.e., challenges him forth, to reveal the real, in the mode of ordering, as standing-reserve," and "Enframing means that way of revealing which holds sway in the essence of modern technology and which is itself nothing technological" (p. 20). Enframing, decisively, is itself a gathering — a gathering that arrests everything gathered into orderability. The essay's late movement turns the danger inward: man himself "comes to the point where he himself will have to be taken as standing-reserve" (pp. 26–27), and yet "precisely as the one so threatened, exalts himself to the posture of lord of the earth" (p. 27). Heidegger frames Heisenberg's observation — "It seems as though man everywhere and always encounters only himself" (p. 27) — only to invert it: "In truth, however, precisely nowhere does man today any longer encounter himself, i.e., his essence" (p. 27). The essay closes on Hölderlin's "But where danger is, grows / The saving power also" (p. 28, requoted p. 34) and on its last line, "For questioning is the piety of thought" (p. 35). "The Age of the World Picture" gives the historical register of the same diagnosis. The modern age is not one in which humanity acquires a picture of the world among other possible pictures; rather, "world picture, when understood essentially, does not mean a picture of the world but the world conceived and grasped as picture" (p. 129, page flagged for print check). This is not a representational accident but the fundamental event of the epoch: "The fundamental event of the modern age is the conquest of the world as picture" (p. 134, independently corroborated). The event has a subjective face: "that the world becomes picture is one and the same event with the event of man's becoming subiectum in the midst of that which is" (p. 132) — "Man becomes the relational center of that which is as such" (p. 128, flagged). The mechanism is Vorstellen: "To represent [vor-stellen] means to bring what is present at hand [das Vorhandene] before oneself as something standing over against, to relate it to oneself, to the one representing it, and to force it back into this relationship to oneself as the normative realm" (p. 131, flagged ±1). World-as-picture and man-as-subiectum are two names for one seizure. ## Essay use ### Source's relevant contribution Heidegger supplies the essay's canonical articulation of the calculative/enframing pole: revealing as challenging-forth, the world converted to standing-reserve, Ge-stell as a gathering, and the world-picture diagnosis of representational seizure.
